name: Knowledge & Documentation Sync (alias of tenant-ingest)
description: DA-03: manual alias for pipelines/tenant-ingest.json — kept because pnpm knowledge:sync and the MCP pipeline_run_allowlist reference this path. v2 was a silent no-op: it looped over knowledge-sync-rules.json `jobs`, which did not exist, and called the since-removed wisdom:knowledge_inject op. The jobs registry is now real (knowledge-sync-rules.json `jobs`) and the actual wiring lives in tenant-ingest.json (cron 02:30 Asia/Tokyo), which this pipeline inlines via core:include.
_migration_note: v3: delegates to pipelines/tenant-ingest.json (DA-03). v2 used wisdom:knowledge_inject against a jobs key that never existed (no-op). Prefer running tenant-ingest.json directly; this alias exists for reference stability.

params.message: 🔄 [KNOWLEDGE] knowledge-sync is an alias — delegating to pipelines/tenant-ingest.json (DA-03 incremental ingest sync).
